name: OSS_BI_SNAPSHOTS_CUST
description: This entity will have the snapshot for Customer extracted from OSS transaction entities for each snapshot record in oss_bi_snapshot_periods.

columns.name: BI_SNAPSHOTS_CUST_ID
columns.description: Primary Key based of  Sequence

columns.name: BI_SNAPSHOT_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: FK to oss_bi_snapshots_cust

columns.name: PERIOD_TYPE
columns.description: Period Type

columns.name: PERIOD_CODE
columns.description: Period Code

columns.name: PRIMARY_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Customer Id

columns.name: NUM_SUBSCRIPTIONS
columns.description: Computed as count of product lines for the period

columns.name: PRODUCT_NET_PRICE
columns.description: Sum of product net price

columns.name: PRODUCT_TOTAL
columns.description: Sum of product total

columns.name: ESTIMATED_TAX
columns.description: Sum of estimated tax

columns.name: INVOICED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Sum of invoiced amount

columns.name: CLOSED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Sum of closed amount

columns.name: CREDITED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Sum of credited amount

columns.name: SUPPRESSED_CREDIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Sum of suppressed credit amount

columns.name: MONTHLY_RECURRING_REVENUE
columns.description: Sum of monthly recurring revenue

columns.name: MRR_CHURN_RENEW_LAPSES
columns.description: Computed as The total MRR of lines which expired without any renewal line created for them

columns.name: MRR_RENEW_CHURN
columns.description: Computed as The Total MRR of lines which were renewed but have been cancelled in this period

columns.name: MRR_NEW_SUBSCRIPTIONS
columns.description: Computed as The total MRR of lines which have no previous relationship and which started in this period

columns.name: NUM_NEW_SUBSCRIPTIONS
columns.description: Computed as The total count of lines which have no previous relationship and which started in this period

columns.name: MRR_AMEND_EXPANSIONS
columns.description: Computed as The difference in MRR between a target and source of an amendment relationship where the target MRR > Source MRR and the target start date falls within this period and not in Draft

columns.name: MRR_AMEND_CONTRACTIONS
columns.description: Computed as The difference in MRR between a target and source of an amendment relationship where the target MRR < Source MRR and the target start date falls within this period and not in Draft

columns.name: MRR_CLOSED_SUBSCRIPTIONS
columns.description: Computed as The total MRR of lines which were closed in this period

columns.name: NUM_CLOSED_SUBSCRIPTIONS
columns.description: Computed as The total count of lines closed in the period

columns.name: DISCOUNT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Computed as Sum of discounts given as bill adjustments

columns.name: TOTAL_QUANTITY
columns.description: Total Product Quantity

columns.name: MRR_DUE_RENEWAL
columns.description: The total MRR of lines which are expiring in that period and which have not been amended/closed/suspended/renewed

columns.name: MRR_RENEW_ACTIVE
columns.description: The total MRR of lines which are targets in a renewal relationship and which start in that period and where the target line status is not draft or canceled

columns.name: NUM_RENEWED_SUBSCRIPTIONS
columns.description: The count of lines which are targets in a renewal relationship and which start in that period and where the target line status is not draft or canceled

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
